integrity: The graph is constructed directly from subspace intersection. A seven-dimensional real Gram representation gives the lower bound and exact minimum rank once an explicit eight-vertex forcing set is supplied. The full polynomial and ten-orbit classification are then obtained by exhaustive finite enumeration and complete enumeration of GL(3,2).
scientific_limitations: The exact polynomial and orbit classification are proved only for the module F_2^3.
The graph convention includes the zero subspace as an isolated vertex, following the cited Yaraneri definition.
The symmetry classification is under the natural GL(3,2) action.
The finite enumeration is exhaustive for this graph but is not an infinite-family proof.
title: Zero forcing and symmetry classes in the Fano module-intersection graph
